[P2] Retain raw control failures during normalization

A raw `CONTROL_ERROR` first discovered during collection is discarded here. `Cloud.collect()` disables `check_controls`, while the normalizer and subsequent quiescence checks inspect only `CONFORMANCE` observations. Consequently, otherwise complete evidence can receive full watermarks and pass despite a recorded control failure. Add raw control errors to the collection errors before filtering observations, and cover an error first collected after execution completes.
